title: Complete Codebase Health & Refactor Audit Across Rust Backend and React Frontend
author: agent-developer (doctor / health auditor)
summary: Conducted a repository-wide codebase health audit and refactoring. In Rust backend: eliminated naked unwrap calls in self-healing board resolution and agent completion in commands/tasks.rs, and replaced expect in llm/client.rs with infallible reqwest::Client::new(). In React frontend: hoisted hooks above early returns in ToolExecutionCard.tsx to strictly enforce React Rules of Hooks; added useRef with defensive double-cleanup across 9 components to prevent unmounted timer memory leaks; added defensive min-h-0 bounding to scrollable flex containers in CortexExplorer and ToolPolicyModal. All sensor gates verified green on main with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
